CustomField.description: Recency window (days) for the FUZZY property-match candidate read (PropertyMatchingService.LOOKBACK_DAYS) — how far back a registration is still a candidate for a similarity match. 🔴 CLAIM-ARBITRATION CONSTANT, same risk category as Protection_Window_Days__c: lowering it in Setup can hide a still-protected claim from the fuzzy path, with NO deploy, NO review and NO undo. 🔴 MUST STAY >= Protection_Window_Days__c — if the window is ever longer than this lookback, a claim in the gap is protected on the exact path and INVISIBLE on the fuzzy path, reintroducing the asymmetry the recency window exists to close. The accessor clamps at runtime (effective lookback = max(this, window)) and logs WARN when the clamp fires — treat that WARN as a live misconfiguration needing a Setup fix.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 🔴 Claim-arbitration constant. Must stay >= Protection Window Days or a fuzzy-match gap opens. See field description before changing.
CustomField.label: Lookback Days
